intro: Mining Consultant is a Northshire Valley quest that sends adventurers to confer with Kelsey Fargo, a mining apprentice stationed outside Echo Ridge Mine. Her observations reveal an unusual development: the local kobolds have begun plundering books from Northshire Abbey's library.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
